name: LumenicMenu
author: LensError
description: Replaces the ChilloutVR Main Menu and Quick Menu with a native Rust UI built on Lumenic. Includes live settings search, Quick Menu pinning, UILib/UIExpansionKit mod bridges, and independent menu toggles.
changelog: Use ChilloutVR Noto Sans fonts, clean top bars and rank tags across all views, normalize QM Main Menu buttons and Props Undo/Redo placement, split User Detail Actions and Moderation cards, clean up LumenicMenu settings with SoftSub default, Recent History toggle, and UserData clear controls.
